0022600155.text: The Pacers (2-4, losers of three straight) host the Nets (0-5, losers of five straight) in Indiana's seventh game of the 2026-27 season, with Indiana 0-2 at home and 12th in the East while Brooklyn sits 15th. Indiana is without Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), and T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Obi Toppin is day-to-day with back soreness and a game-time decision, while Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg bruise) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain). The Pacers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 136-109 win in Brooklyn on October 25, and they also won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
